Job Description: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain low-level C/C++ firmware for resource-constrained IoT hardware devices and microcontrollers.
- Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to review schematics, debug board-bringup issues, and implement communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART.
- Write automated unit tests and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test suites to ensure system reliability and real-time performance constraints.
- Optimize power consumption, memory footprint, and processing efficiency for battery-operated embedded systems.
- Participate in peer code reviews, document firmware architecture, and manage release pipelines using Git and CI/CD tools.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field.
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in embedded software development, systems programming, or a similar hardware-software integration role.
- Strong proficiency in C and C++ programming languages, with a deep understanding of memory management, concurrency, and real-time operating systems (RTOS).
- Hands-on experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers.
- Demonstrated ability to read electrical schematics and translate hardware specifications into robust firmware drivers.
output:
Score: 10
Rationale: The candidate's resume shows zero background in embedded systems, C/C++ programming, hardware engineering, or IoT development, focusing instead entirely on K-12 educational technology and online learning management systems. Furthermore, the required 5 years of professional experience in systems programming and hardware-software integration are completely absent, making this a severe domain and technical mismatch.

Job Description: Director of Performing Arts

Pine Crest Independent School is seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Performing Arts to lead, revitalize, and expand our vibrant theater and drama program for grades 9-12. The ideal candidate will oversee all artistic, technical, and budgetary aspects of our theatrical productions, directing 3 to 4 mainstage plays and musicals annually alongside several student-led studio performances. 

Responsibilities:
- Design and teach a comprehensive academic curriculum spanning acting, directing, playwrighting, physical theater, and theater design.
- Direct multiple mainstage and studio theatrical productions per year, managing all creative, technical, and production timelines.
- Collaborate across academic departments to integrate the performing arts with broader school curricula and organize visiting artist workshops.
- Partner with the school’s communications and marketing team to provide media assets, photography, and promotional copy for productions.
- Serve as an academic adviser, mentor students, and participate in the residential life or co-curricular activities of our independent school community.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Theater, Fine Arts, or a related field; Master’s degree in Directing or Theater Education preferred.
- Minimum of 7 to 10 years of experience directing theater and teaching performing arts within an independent secondary school or similar educational setting.
- Proven track record of building and managing award-winning scholastic theater programs, including budgeting, set/costume oversight, and technical direction.
- Strong proficiency in digital photography, media documentation, and basic web/LMS platforms to support departmental outreach.
- Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and student mentorship capabilities.

Job Description: Lead Embedded Systems Firmware Engineer

We are seeking a Lead Embedded Systems Firmware Engineer to architect, develop, and maintain low-level C and C++ code for our next-generation IoT microcontrollers and real-time operating systems (RTOS). The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of hardware-software integration, digital signal processing, and low-power circuit design principles.

Responsibilities:
- Design, write, and debug robust embedded firmware for resource-constrained ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers using C and assembly language.
- Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to review schematics, validate board bring-up, and troubleshoot complex electronic hardware issues using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
- Optimize power consumption and memory footprints for battery-operated IoT edge devices deployed in industrial environments.
- Implement secure communication protocols (BLE, Wi-Fi, MQTT) and manage over-the-air (OTA) firmware update pipelines.
- Mentor junior firmware engineers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and establish best practices for continuous integration and automated hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Minimum of 7 years of hands-on professional experience in embedded software development and bare-metal programming.
- Advanced proficiency in C/C++ programming, multithreading, and peripheral driver development (SPI, I2C, UART, USB).
- Demonstrated track record of shipping complex hardware-software products from concept through mass production.
- Strong debugging skills and familiarity with modern version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for embedded systems.

Job Description: Senior Nanotechnology Research Scientist

Job Summary:
We are seeking an advanced Senior Nanotechnology Research Scientist to lead our cutting-edge laboratory initiatives. The ideal candidate will spearhead the development, synthesis, and characterization of novel nanoscale materials and advanced molecular devices. You will direct complex scientific experiments, manage state-of-the-art cleanroom equipment, and publish groundbreaking research in peer-reviewed journals.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, execute, and oversee complex experiments involving nanomaterials synthesis, atomic layer deposition, and nanoscale fabrication.
- Lead a multidisciplinary team of research scientists and junior lab technicians, providing expert scientific direction and ensuring rigorous adherence to safety protocols.
- Author grant proposals, secure federal and private research funding, and manage laboratory budgets.
- Analyze high-dimensional characterization data using advanced spectroscopic and microscopic techniques, including TEM, SEM, and XRD.
- Collaborate with academic and industry partners to translate laboratory discoveries into scalable commercial applications.

Requirements:
- Ph.D. in Nanotechnology, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related doctoral discipline.
- Minimum of 7 to 10 years of post-doctoral research experience in advanced nanotechnology or semiconductor manufacturing environments.
- Proven track record of securing research grants and a strong publication record in high-impact scientific journals.
- Hands-on expertise with advanced cleanroom instrumentation and nanoparticle characterization methods.
- Demonstrated leadership experience managing scientific teams and directing complex R&D projects from conception to completion.
output:
Score: 10
Rationale: The candidate lacks the required Ph.D. and 7 to 10 years of post-doctoral research experience mandated by the job description, holding only a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. Furthermore, while the resume lists a brief past role as a Technical Director involving nanotechnology processes, it completely lacks the required track record of grant acquisition, high-impact scientific publications, and advanced characterization expertise like TEM and SEM.

Job Description: Job Title: Senior Staff Accountant

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Staff Accountant to join our growing finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing core accounting operations, ensuring the integrity of our general ledger, and driving month-end and year-end close processes. You will collaborate closely with management to analyze financial performance, manage cash flow, and identify cost-saving opportunities across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage full-cycle accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliations.
- Coordinate and execute timely month-end and year-end close procedures, ensuring all journal entries and accruals are accurate.
- Prepare comprehensive financial statements, variance analyses, and operational reports to guide executive decision-making.
- Monitor corporate budgets, oversee cost accounting practices, and assist in maintaining perpetual inventory integrity.
- Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal tax regulations and assist with corporate tax filings.
- Act as a primary point of contact for external auditors, banks, and vendors.
- Participate in the implementation and optimization of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and internal controls.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
- 3 to 5 years of progressive corporate accounting experience, with a strong background in general ledger management and financial statement preparation.
- Proven experience with ERP systems and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
- Solid understanding of GAAP, cost accounting principles, and corporate tax compliance.
- Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
output:
Score: 95
Rationale: The candidate exceeds requirements with a Master’s in Accounting, over 5 years of progressive corporate accounting experience, and direct expertise in general ledger management, ERP implementation, and month-end close as outlined in the job description. Furthermore, their proven history of managing full-cycle accounting operations and cost-saving initiatives aligns seamlessly with the core responsibilities of the Senior Staff Accountant role.

- Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and continuous integration pipelines for embedded targets.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and test low-level software for our next-generation IoT hardware devices. Job Description: Senior Manufacturing Plant Controller

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Plant Controller to lead the financial operations of our high-volume manufacturing facility. In this role, you will partner directly with the plant manager and executive leadership to drive operational excellence, optimize profit margins, and ensure robust financial governance.

- Partner with operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify and execute cost-reduction initiatives, productivity projects, and margin improvement strategies.
- Manage inventory accounting, oversee annual physical inventories, and drive continuous improvements to reduce inventory holding costs and cycle count discrepancies.
- Streamline the month-end close process and refine internal control procedures to enhance reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.
- Provide cross-functional financial leadership, offering data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making across production, sourcing, and logistics.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; Master’s degree preferred. Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation is required.
- 8+ years of progressive financial experience within a manufacturing or industrial environment, with at least 3 years in a Plant Controller or senior finance leadership role.
- Demonstrated expertise in cost accounting, variance analysis, inventory management, and financial forecasting.
- Hands-on experience with major ERP systems (such as Oracle, JD Edwards, or SAP) and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
- Strong knowledge of US GAAP, internal controls, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean / Six Sigma).
- Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven track record of collaborating with non-financial plant personnel to achieve financial goals.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer

Troubleshoot complex hardware-software integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and advanced debugging tools.

Deep hands-on experience with Yocto Project, cross-compilation toolchains, and custom Linux distribution creation.
Strong understanding of real-time operating systems (RTOS), concurrency, multithreading, and memory management in resource-constrained environments.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to design, develop, and test firmware for next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) hardware devices. You will work closely with our hardware and software engineering teams to architect low-level drivers, optimize power consumption, and implement real-time operating systems (RTOS) on ARM Cortex microcontrollers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, code, and debug embedded C and C++ firmware for complex microcontroller-based systems.
- Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to review schematics, validate board bring-up, and troubleshoot hardware-software integration issues.
- Develop and maintain low-level peripheral drivers (I2C, SPI, UART, USB) and wireless communication protocols (BLE, Wi-Fi).
- Write comprehensive unit tests and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to ensure system reliability and performance.
- Optimize firmware for memory constraints, execution speed, and ultra-low power consumption in battery-operated devices.
- Participate in code reviews, write technical documentation, and mentor junior embedded engineers.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Minimum of 7+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development and hardware-software integration.
- Advanced proficiency in C/C++ programming for resource-constrained environments.
- Deep hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-M architecture, RTOS (FreeRTOS, ThreadX), and debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG).
- Demonstrated track record of shipping commercial IoT or embedded products from concept to production.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer

We are seeking a highly technical Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain low-level firmware for our next-generation IoT hardware products. You will work closely with our hardware engineering teams to write robust, efficient C and C++ code for real-time operating systems (RTOS) and bare-metal microcontrollers.

Design, implement, debug, and test firmware for ARM Cortex-M and similar microcontroller architectures.
Develop device drivers for communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, and BLE.
Collaborate with hardware design teams to review schematics, validate board bring-up, and troubleshoot complex electrical and timing issues using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
Optimize software for power consumption, memory footprint, and processing speed in resource-constrained environments.
Participate in rigorous peer code reviews, write automated unit tests, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation throughout the software development lifecycle.
Implement secure boot, OTA (over-the-air) firmware update mechanisms, and hardware-based encryption protocols.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to architectural decisions for upcoming product roadmaps.

Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in embedded software development using C and C++.
Demonstrated expertise in RTOS internals, multi-threading, synchronization primitives, and memory management.
Hands-on experience with hardware debugging tools, including JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analyzers, and digital storage oscilloscopes.
Strong understanding of electronic circuit design, reading schematics, and hardware data sheets.
Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and continuous integration pipelines for embedded systems.
Experience with wireless communication stacks (Wi-Fi, Zigbee, or Bluetooth Low Energy) is strongly preferred.

- Strong background in writing device drivers, optimizing memory constraints, and implementing robust error-handling mechanisms in resource-constrained environments.

Job Description: Facilities and Equipment Maintenance Technician

We are seeking a reliable and mechanically inclined Facilities and Equipment Maintenance Technician to join our operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring all facility infrastructure, machinery, and grounds are maintained to high safety and operational standards. You will perform routine preventative maintenance, diagnose equipment failures, and execute necessary repairs efficiently.

Responsibilities:
- Perform scheduled preventative maintenance and routine inspections on facility equipment, machinery, and infrastructure.
- Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and structural issues, diagnosing root causes and implementing effective repairs using hand and power tools.
- Maintain and repair building systems, grounds, roads, and fencing as needed to ensure a safe working environment.
- Document daily maintenance activities, equipment inspections, and repair logs accurately for quality assurance and compliance purposes.
- Assist with inventory control by restocking tools, parts, and maintenance supplies.
- Adhere strictly to all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and standard operating procedures while executing tasks.
- Collaborate with other departments to support infrastructure projects, layout changes, and facility upgrades.

Requirements:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or coursework in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred.
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in facilities maintenance, mechanical repair, or heavy equipment servicing.
- Strong proficiency in using hand tools, power tools, diagnostic equipment, and pneumatic systems.
- Demonstrated ability to read technical manuals, blueprints, and grade stakes or schematics.
- Excellent problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail and a commitment to workplace safety.
- Ability to lift heavy objects, stand for extended periods, and perform physical labor in various weather and facility conditions.
output:
Score: 90
Rationale: The candidate strongly matches the job requirements with over 3 years of facilities and mechanical maintenance experience, coupled with a 4.0 GPA in Industrial Maintenance from Lamar Institute of Technology. The resume specifically details hands-on competencies in preventative maintenance, equipment repair, hand and power tool usage, and safety documentation that directly align with the job description.

- Expert proficiency in C and C++ programming with a strong understanding of object-oriented principles applied to microcontrollers.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer

Title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
Location: Remote / Hybrid

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to design, develop, and deploy low-level firmware and hardware-software interfaces for our next generation of autonomous IoT devices. You will work closely with hardware designers to write highly optimized C and C++ code running on RTOS and bare-metal ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

Responsibilities:
- Architect, write, and maintain robust firmware in C and C++ for resource-constrained IoT hardware platforms.
- Design communication protocols including SPI, I2C, UART, and CAN bus for peripheral device integration.
- Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to review schematics, debug board-bringup issues, and validate electrical performance using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
- Implement security best practices for embedded devices, including secure boot, hardware root of trust, and encrypted storage.
- Optimize power consumption and memory footprints to meet strict battery life and performance targets.
- Participate in code reviews, write unit tests, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated firmware regression testing.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field.
- 7+ years of professional experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, or low-level systems programming.
- Deep proficiency in C, C++, and assembly language for microcontrollers.
- Hands-on experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and bare-metal firmware development.
- Strong debugging skills using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
- Familiarity with hardware communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, USB).
output:
Score: 12
Rationale: The candidate has zero professional experience in embedded systems, firmware development, C++, or hardware engineering, as their background is entirely in enterprise desktop architecture and IT administration. While they possess a Bachelor's in Business/MIS and programming skills in VB.NET/C#, these completely lack the domain overlap, low-level microcontroller expertise, and hardware debugging requirements specified in the job description.

Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and automated CI/CD pipelines for embedded builds.
Demonstrated ability to drive projects independently in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment.

Job Description: Senior Full-Stack Cloud Software Engineer

Job Summary:
We are seeking an innovative Senior Full-Stack Cloud Software Engineer to design, build, and scale our enterprise-grade microservices architecture. In this role, you will architect cloud-native solutions using modern distributed systems paradigms, leveraging Kubernetes, Docker, and serverless compute on AWS. You will collaborate closely with product management and platform engineering teams to deliver high-performance APIs and reactive front-end interfaces utilizing React and TypeScript. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, and deploy robust microservices and distributed backend systems using Go, Python, and Node.js.
- Build responsive, user-facing web applications utilizing modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Redux, and TypeScript.
- Architect and manage scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions.
- Optimize database performance and manage data persistence layers across relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB) systems.
- Mentor junior engineers, conduct thorough code reviews, and drive engineering best practices around automated testing, security, and observability.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building large-scale distributed cloud applications.
- Demonstrated expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Go, and cloud-native container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

Job Description: Senior Pediatric Registered Nurse (RN)
Department: Pediatrics
Reports to: Director of Nursing

Position Summary:
We are seeking an empathetic and dedicated Senior Pediatric Registered Nurse to join our fast-paced children's hospital unit. The ideal candidate will provide direct, high-quality patient care to infants, children, and adolescents suffering from various acute and chronic illnesses. Responsibilities include conducting comprehensive patient assessments, administering medications and intravenous therapies, developing individualized care plans, and monitoring vital signs. The role also requires collaborating closely with physicians, pediatric specialists, and multidisciplinary healthcare teams to ensure optimal clinical outcomes. Candidates must educate patients and their families on post-discharge care, manage medical emergencies with poise, and maintain accurate electronic health records (EHR) in compliance with hospital standards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Deliver compassionate bedside nursing care to pediatric patients ranging from newborns to teenagers.
- Administer prescribed medications, calculate precise dosages based on pediatric weight, and manage IV lines.
- Monitor patient conditions, recognize subtle clinical changes, and initiate immediate life-saving interventions when necessary.
- Coordinate care plans with doctors, therapists, and social workers to support holistic patient recovery.
- Educate families regarding disease management, treatment regimens, and home-care procedures.
- Document all nursing care, patient responses, and medical interventions accurately in the EHR system.

Requirements:
- Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing.
- Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree from an accredited institution.
- Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience in a dedicated pediatric ward or PICU/NICU setting.
- Current BLS and PALS (Pediatric Advanced Life Support) certifications.
- Demonstrated expertise in pediatric pharmacology, wound care, and family-centered communication.

Job Description: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the conceptualization, development, and validation of complex electromechanical systems for our next-generation industrial manufacturing equipment. In this role, you will own the end-to-end design lifecycle from initial CAD modeling and tolerance stack-up analysis to prototyping, finite element analysis (FEA), and final shop-floor manufacturing integration.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop robust mechanical components, assemblies, and thermal management systems using SolidWorks and ANSYS.
- Perform advanced structural and thermal FEA simulations to ensure components meet rigorous safety, durability, and performance standards under extreme operating conditions.
- Lead multidisciplinary design reviews with electrical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure seamless system integration and design for manufacturability (DFM).
- Author detailed engineering drawings, bills of materials (BOM), and technical specifications complying with ASME and ISO standards.
- Oversee prototype builds, coordinate rigorous physical testing regimens, and perform root-cause failure analysis on returned or failed hardware.
- Mentor junior mechanical engineers, establish internal design best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the R&D department.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 7+ years of hands-on experience in mechanical product design, machine design, or hardware development within a heavy manufacturing or robotics environment.
- Expert-level proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) and PDM/PLM data management systems.
- Demonstrated mastery of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and tolerance analysis methodologies.
- Strong background in finite element analysis (FEA) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) for stress, vibration, and thermal optimization.
- Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with a proven track record of managing vendors, fabricators, and external manufacturing partners.

Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Linux kernel architecture, memory management, scheduler, and device tree configuration.
Proven track record of successfully porting Linux to custom hardware platforms and contributing patches to open-source kernel communities.
Extensive experience with Git version control, Yocto Project / OpenEmbedded build systems, and cross-compilation toolchains.
Familiarity with hardware communication protocols (CAN, UART, PCIe, Ethernet) and debugging tools such as GDB and Valgrind.

Job Description: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer

Job Title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer
Department: Engineering
Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid)

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to design, develop, and test low-level software for our next-generation IoT hardware devices. You will work closely with hardware design teams to write robust C/C++ code, implement real-time operating systems (RTOS), and optimize power consumption for battery-operated connected devices.

Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, debug, and maintain embedded C/C++ firmware for microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M architecture).
- Develop and integrate drivers for various communication protocols including SPI, I2C, UART, BLE, and Wi-Fi.
- Participate in schematic and PCB layout reviews from a firmware perspective to ensure hardware-software co-design efficiency.
- Perform rigorous unit testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and emulators.
- Optimize firmware for low-power consumption, memory utilization, and real-time performance constraints.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware engineers, cloud developers, and product managers to define system requirements and deployment pipelines.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred.
- 5+ years of professional experience in embedded firmware development and hardware debugging.
- Advanced proficiency in C and C++ programming for resource-constrained embedded systems.
- Proven hands-on experience working with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and bare-metal systems.
- Solid understanding of networking stacks and wireless communication protocols (BLE, Zigbee, or Wi-Fi).
- Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and automated CI/CD pipelines for embedded builds.

- Evaluate investment opportunities, mergers, acquisitions, and capital projects through detailed discounted cash flow (DCF) and return on investment (ROI) analyses.
- Automate and streamline reporting workflows using advanced Excel, SQL, and business intelligence platforms to improve data accuracy and efficiency.

- Strong understanding of US GAAP accounting principles and corporate finance metrics.
